Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5604062. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5604062'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
